name: Semantic Obfuscation of Algebraic Conditions
description: Replaces explicit inequalities ("combined processing time strictly exceeds T", "aggregate processing time... strictly exceeds T") with their exact physical scheduling equivalents ("sequential progression... cannot fit within the time allowed", "total duration of active work... cannot fit within the time allowed"). This forces models to derive the `p1+p2 > T` and `sum > T` checks from the scheduling mechanics rather than pattern-matching explicit formulas.
